تفتقدين (form VIII)
# تَفْتَقِدِينَ (taftaqidīna) /taf.ta.qi.diː.na/: second-person feminine singular non-past active indicative of اِفْتَقَدَ (iftaqada)
# تُفْتَقَدِينَ (tuftaqadīna) /tuf.ta.qa.diː.na/: second-person feminine singular non-past passive indicative of اِفْتَقَدَ (iftaqada)
